name: Alchemy-Chromium (patched Chromium)
script:
set -x
# /work/src = DreamScape/Alchemy-Chromium (master); the Chromium checkout and every cache live on the pipeline's own LV (/cache = <builds>/alchemy-chromium/cache).
git config --global --add safe.directory '*'
mkdir -p /cache/chromium /cache/ccache && cd /cache/chromium
# build-alchemy.sh from the repo is the single source of the gn args, patch list and package layout (it is what Core ran).
# Adjusted for the container only: ROOT is the cache checkout, no sudo install-build-deps (the image carries the packages), ccache wraps the compiler.
cp /work/src/build-alchemy.sh /cache/build-alchemy.run.sh
sed -i 's|^ROOT=.*|ROOT=/cache/chromium|; /install-build-deps/d' /cache/build-alchemy.run.sh
sed -i 's|^HERE=.*|HERE=/work/src|' /cache/build-alchemy.run.sh
sed -i '/^use_siso = false$/a cc_wrapper = "ccache"' /cache/build-alchemy.run.sh
grep -q 'cc_wrapper = "ccache"' /cache/build-alchemy.run.sh && grep -q '^ROOT=/cache/chromium' /cache/build-alchemy.run.sh && ! grep -q install-build-deps /cache/build-alchemy.run.sh
export CCACHE_DIR=/cache/ccache CCACHE_BASEDIR=/cache/chromium/src CCACHE_COMPILERCHECK=content CCACHE_SLOPPINESS=time_macros CCACHE_MAXSIZE=60G
export JOBS=${JOBS:-80}
echo "[rack] chromium tag $TAG, jobs $JOBS, start $(date -Is)"
# a checkout already at the tag skips the sync (a repeat shallow sync refetches for 20+ min and once hung); a new TAG or an empty cache syncs
V=$(sed -n 's/^MAJOR=//p;s/^MINOR=//p;s/^BUILD=//p;s/^PATCH=//p' /cache/chromium/src/chrome/VERSION 2>/dev/null | paste -sd.)
if [ -z "${STAGE:-}" ]; then if [ "$V" = "$TAG" ]; then STAGE=after-sync; else STAGE=all; fi; fi
echo "[rack] checkout at '$V', stage $STAGE"
bash /cache/build-alchemy.run.sh "$TAG" "$STAGE"
ccache -s || true
mkdir -p /out && cp /cache/chromium/alchemy-chromium-$TAG.tar.gz /out/ && (cd /out && sha256sum alchemy-chromium-$TAG.tar.gz > alchemy-chromium-$TAG.tar.gz.sha256)
echo "[rack] end $(date -Is)"
